plain: Notification sent when a new staff request is submitted.
Email_Content: A new staff request has been submitted and is awaiting your review. Please open the request record to verify the details and take the required action.

plain: Notification sent when a staff transfer request is approved.
Email_Content: The staff transfer request has been approved. Please coordinate with the receiving campus and update any related employment records.

plain: Notification sent when training is assigned to staff.
Email_Content: A training activity has been assigned. Kindly review the training schedule and ensure attendance is recorded after completion.

plain: Notification sent when a resignation request needs review.
Email_Content: A resignation request is pending review. Please check the submitted information and complete the approval process promptly.

plain: Notification sent after position update completion.
Email_Content: The staff position update has been completed successfully. The updated role information is now available in the staff profile.
